cards.headline: Refining & Downstream leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Refining & Downstream at +6.12%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -1.84%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.
